## Description

Decomposes intraday price series using Discrete Wavelet Transforms to filter high-frequency noise, feeding cleaned multi-scale frequency coefficients into a shallow neural network for trend scalping.

## Where it may fit

Noisy intraday trending markets, choppy opening ranges, momentum breakout validation.

## Vehicles

Intraday proprietary trading firms, systematic crypto funds.

## Required data

1-minute and 5-minute OHLCV bar data, wavelet filter coefficients, normalization scalars.

## Caveats

Care must be taken to prevent look-ahead bias during wavelet decomposition rolling window alignment.
